subtitle.text: Fairhaven. A city the outbreak has not reached: clean streets, open shops, an organized army. For the first time all day, it feels like it is over.

Fairhaven. A city the outbreak has not reached: clean streets, open shops, an organized army. For the first time all day, it feels like it is over.
Welcome to Fairhaven. Please proceed to registration.
It is yours. Short bursts, and stay with the line.
Military perimeter secured. Stay behind the barriers. They are piling up at the wire!
Alpha at the west wall! It is tearing at the wire!
Contact! All sides! Hold the plaza!
The west wall is down! They are pouring in! Hold the breach!
Alpha at the north wall, by the guns!
North wall breached! Hold the gap!
They are inside the wire! Line one, fall back to the guns!
Alpha at the south wall! Lakeshore side!
The guns are down! Back to the trucks, move!
South wall breached! Hold the gap!
The tank has gone quiet. They are all over it!
Fall back! Get to the cellar!
The cellar under Kessler’s Hardware, far end of Harbor Street! Take Lakeshore, then Metro Road north. Keep moving!
Above, the war goes on. Down here, one bulb holds.

hold: Hold the plaza with the army
